title: The Titan Files
address: Julis Romo Rabinowitz Building, Princeton University, Princeton, NJ
summary: On 2026-03-09 Halvorsen Dynamics opened an investigation into whether the Titan thruster design files left the isolated laptop in room 219. Senior engineer Hank Gibson resigned on 2026-03-02 to join Northline Systems. The case holds floor access, Wi-Fi, laptop, CCTV, IT, communications and financial records from 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-08, plus interview statements taken on 2026-03-09.
